text:
maria: quick heads-up, ran a linkscan on the new onboarding guide and found ~10 footnote links pointing at a deleted gist (404s). docs-bot flagged them in the scan results. :mag_right:

docs-bot: automated scan detected 10 dead URLs in `docs/onboarding/get-started.md` footnotes (lines 230-320). Report ID: scan-2026-03-22-0812.

maria: tagging owners — @sam @lee who did the onboarding edits last month? can one of you take a look or assign? ideally a tiny patch replacing the gist links with our hosted snippet or moving to a KB page.

sam: I touched that file for the sample snippets. I can take a quick look this afternoon. do we have a preferred target for the content? put it in KB or keep inline?

maria: prefer KB page `kb/snippets/onboarding-examples` so we can update centrally. small note: some footnotes reference line numbers inside the gist, so we should either host a static snippet page or inline the relevant snippet and drop the footnote link.

lee: if it's just replacing links + small copy, happy to help. if samples need edits, I can handle the snippet normalization. I might be OOO tomorrow AM though.

oliver: +1 for KB. also suggest adding a short redirect note so old gist URLs don't break CI link checks while we patch. we can create a tiny redirect in `docs/shortlinks/` that maps the old gist url -> new KB page.

maria: good call. sam — if you want me to, I can spin up the KB page and draft the redirect. otherwise LMK and i'll queue it for a weekend microfix.

sam: i'll grab it. plan: 1) add KB page with snippets 2) update footnote links to point to KB 3) add a temporary redirect in `shortlinks/` 4) open PR and ping for quick review. should be <30min.

lee: ping me when PR is up, i'll sanity-check the snippets and run the local build.

sam: draft PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/docs/pulls/4268 (WIP) — changed two footnotes so far, left notes for the other 8. CI running.

docs-bot: PR status update: checks started for PR #4268. Link-scan will re-run on merge.

maria: thanks. please add `@docs` in the PR body for visibility. also add a short changelog line under "internal: fix footnote links" so the release notes capture internal KB fixes.

sam: done — PR body updated and @docs added. small sed to replace one type of footnote link if anyone needs it locally:

```bash
# replace gist links that match gist.example.com/OLDID with /kb/snippets/onboarding-examples
sed -i 's|https://gist.example.com/OLDID#L[0-9]\+|/kb/snippets/onboarding-examples|g' docs/onboarding/get-started.md
```

oliver: heads-up: after merge i'll queue the redirect in shortlinks so the external 404 window is minimal. recommend merging during the low-traffic window (US evening) to avoid flapping the staging link checks.

lee: LGTM on the approach. if CI complains about markdown lint (frontmatter anchor references), i can push a tiny follow-up.

sam: CI is green for the two changes so far. requesting review from @lee and @oliver.

lee: reviewing now. small nit: a footnote's code fence lost the language hint, i'll patch in the PR comment.

sam: patched the fence and pushed. thanks.

oliver: once merged i'll drop the redirect PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/docs/pulls/4270 — will link it from the merge commit.

maria: amazing, thanks for the fast turnaround. one follow-up ask: can someone add a quick test case to our linkscan config to ignore temporary redirects from `shortlinks/` for 48h after a change? we keep seeing transient 404s during the change window.

sam: noted. i'll open a follow-up issue for linkscan tweak and tag infra.

maria: perfect. resolving on my side for now — will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
